orthogonal_functional_surface_gate.rule: All functional components must be square-on, axis-aligned, and measurable. Any component that carries information, state, click, hover, pressed, disabled, selected, drag-over, or other player-facing operation semantics must use a 0-degree orthogonal functional face. Decorative outer paper edges may be irregular, but content_rects, hit_rects, and state_rects must remain 0-degree rectangles.
reject_if: content_rect is tilted, rotated, skewed, trapezoid, or perspective
hit_rect follows a diagonal paper edge
status ticket or CTA plate uses a non-axis-aligned writable face
model uses a tilted paper sheet as the main functional panel
the manually drawn QA box is orthogonal but the actual generated component edge remains slanted
allowed_decoration: back-page tabs and folder露边 outside no_text_rects
shadow and paper layering outside functional faces

style_retention_gate.rule: The orthogonal correction must preserve the clean low-poly weekly benchmark language. Functional faces stay square-on, but their skins must retain broad flat polygonal color-value planes, large color blocks, subtle cut-paper shadows, and hand-cut sticker/icon irregularity. Readability zones may be quiet and must not show crease/wrinkle/fold/tear lines; component bodies must not become flat software panels.
required: central map landmasses use fewer larger low-poly planes rather than dense triangulation
left region cards keep visible broad faceted color blocks in card bodies and colored frames
right dossier sheet keeps paper-body polygonal value blocks outside calm runtime text rectangles
CTA plates and bottom receipts keep 4-8 large flat low-poly value planes per component without crease, fold, or tear lines through text slots
sticker/icon atlas keeps hand-cut, hand-drawn graphic tension rather than regular software icon geometry
reject_if: geometry passes but component shells become flat empty rectangles
map reads as GIS triangulation or fine mesh texture
low-poly treatment appears only inside thumbnails and not on the UI component bodies
readability is achieved by erasing all color blocks and cut-paper value shifts
icons become perfectly regular vector toolbar glyphs
high-contrast diagonal folded-corner, torn-paper, crease, or wrinkle patches appear inside functional cards, CTA plates, bottom receipts, dossier text bodies, or label slots

layout_regions.role: low-weight global week and macro status

layout_regions.notes: Map itself may contain faceted landmass shapes, but the board frame remains axis-aligned. Do not bake region names or route lines into the map art.

layout_regions.role: selected region summary and action stack
layout_regions.notes: Dossier sheet may have uneven outer cut edges, but header, media frame, tickets, CTA plates, and all hit rectangles must be parallel to canvas edges.

layout_regions.role: fixed decorative and state icon source
layout_regions.notes: Stickers may be hand-cut and slightly rotated because they do not carry dynamic text or hit rects.

generation_rejection_rules: any CTA plate tilted or trapezoid
any hit_rect or state surface implied by a diagonal visual face
any dynamic text baked into the texture
any placeholder text blocks inside content_rects
selected region rendered as saturated yellow-green instead of low-chroma olive
cross-map route lines baked into the art
dense micro details, tiny holes, barcode clutter, or photographic grain over text zones
dense triangulated world-map mesh instead of broad low-poly planes
flat software-panel component bodies with no broad polygonal color-value blocks
orthogonality achieved by erasing the benchmark's color-block material language
